title: Unauthorized $40 Charge and No Response!!!!
body: I had a very disappointing experience as I was charged $40 for a subscription that I did not sign up for. I double-checked my subscriptions on my iPhone and found no active subscription. I assumed that the free trial would end and I would revert to the basic version if I chose to renew. However, I received a notification from my bank that I was charged, and despite sending two refund requests, I received no response! It also seems like this is a repeated issue with many users so I’m not sure why they are not updating their payment method to prevent this from happening? It really gives the impression that they might be scamming unaware users. Very unprofessional and frustrating. I would not recommend this app at all!

title: Thieves
body:
Don’t try the free trial ESPECIALLY WHEN YOU GET THE EMAIL. 

I wanted to try this app.. and i really didn’t like it which is fine. It’s not for everyone. But then they reached out to me by email offering a one month trial period and I thought why not try it a little longer.

What i didn’t realise is that when i tried to cancel the trial, it never went into effect and I didn’t notice that because they didn’t show the subscription in my app subscription on the phone.. they had basically given me a trial on the web.. not only did they charge me for a FULL YEAR when i wanted to cancel, they also charged me almost DOUBLE what they said they would on the app.

And because i realised all this a month later (while checking my bank statement) they said it was too late.
